metadata.title: Job Post Builder Never Hits Send.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: if Claude can open DocuSign and set up the whole offer, will it also hit send? Lands the carry-out that it drafts everything — job post, interview guide, offer letter, even the DocuSign envelope — but never sends or publishes anything without you.
metadata.anchor_pair: N/A — source is skill-teardown format (anatomy -> pipeline -> constraint -> verdict), no anchor structure to preserve

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes once Claude finishes the hiring packet, it sends the offer. It doesn't — it opens DocuSign, sets up the envelope, and stops at a draft, waiting for you to hit send.

beats.act: 1 anatomy — a skill is a folder
beats.narration_text: This kind of building is a skill — a folder Claude reads before it works. Inside sits one instruction file, plus a references folder holding the real templates: the job post structure, the interview guide, the offer letter. Claude reads the file, then works through those templates in order.

shot.new_visual_element: A folder icon opening to reveal SKILL.md, references/ with job-post-structure.md, interview-guide-structure.md, offer-letter-template.md; SKILL.md highlighted

production_viz.label: A skill is a folder
production_viz.mechanic: A folder opens on cream to reveal SKILL.md (highlighted in crimson) and a references/ folder listing three template files: job-post-structure.md, interview-guide-structure.md, offer-letter-template.md. A caption below reads 'Claude reads it, then works through the templates.'

beats.narration_text: The pipeline runs in six steps, always in order: gather the role's context, research comparable postings, write the job post, draft the interview guide and its scoring rubric, assemble the offer letter, and only if you ask, walk through setting up DocuSign. Each step waits for the one before it.

shot.new_visual_element: Six-phase pipeline in two rows: gather context, research market, write job post / interview guide, offer letter, DocuSign (if asked)

production_viz.label: Six steps, in order
production_viz.mechanic: Six small cards in two rows of three, joined by arrows: 'Gather context' -> 'Research market' -> 'Write job post', wrapping down to 'Interview guide' -> 'Offer letter' -> 'DocuSign (if asked)'. Linear, no branch points drawn.

beats.narration_text: But there are three hard stops built into this skill: it will never send the DocuSign envelope, never send the fallback email if DocuSign fails, and never publish the job post anywhere. It builds every draft right up to the edge, then stops and waits for you to say go.

shot.new_visual_element: Three stop rows: DocuSign envelope, fallback email, job post — each marked 'draft only, never sent/published'; a boundary line captioned 'waits for your go-ahead'

production_viz.label: Three hard stops
production_viz.mechanic: Three rows fill in one at a time with a pause mark: 'DocuSign envelope — draft only, never sent', 'Fallback email — drafted, never sent', 'Job post — file only, never published'. A dashed boundary line beneath the list, captioned 'waits for your go-ahead'.

beats.narration_text: It drafts the whole hiring packet — job post, interview guide, offer letter — and it will even open DocuSign and build the envelope. It will never hit send without you.

props.quote: It drafts the whole hiring packet — job post, interview guide, offer letter — and it will even open DocuSign and build the envelope. It will never hit send without you.
props.sparkLine: Drafts everything. Sends nothing on its own.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Ask Claude: I'm hiring a marketing coordinator — draft the job post, a three-stage interview guide with a scoring rubric, and an offer letter template, and before anything gets sent or posted anywhere, stop and check with me first. Liam, in for Bear.
